name: digestseo-mcp
description: Track how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews cite your brand.
long_description: Self-hosted AI visibility tracking over MCP. Runs buyer-intent prompts against the AI engines you hold API keys for, records which ones cite your brand versus competitors, and exposes six tools: check_visibility, get_visibility_history, compare_competitors, get_citations, get_content_gaps, refresh_brand. All data stays in a local SQLite database under ~/.digestseo.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API Key (ChatGPT engine)
openai_api_key.description: Optional — every engine key is opt-in, but at least one of the five is required for the server to do anything useful. Engines without a key are skipped gracefully.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API Key (Claude engine)
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional — also powers prompt generation and content-gap analysis via Claude Haiku. At least one of the five engine keys is required.

gemini_api_key.title: Google AI Studio API Key (Gemini engine)
gemini_api_key.description: Optional — free tier available at aistudio.google.com. At least one of the five engine keys is required.

perplexity_api_key.title: Perplexity API Key (Perplexity engine)
perplexity_api_key.description: Optional — paid plans only. At least one of the five engine keys is required.

serpapi_api_key.title: SerpAPI Key (Google AI Overviews engine)
serpapi_api_key.description: Optional — free tier covers ~100 searches/month. At least one of the five engine keys is required.

tools.name: check_visibility
tools.description: Latest AI visibility snapshot for a tracked brand with per-engine scores.

tools.name: get_visibility_history
tools.description: Time-series history of overall and per-engine visibility.

tools.name: get_citations
tools.description: Actual citation events with prompts, excerpts, and citation type.

tools.name: get_content_gaps
tools.description: Prioritized content recommendations targeting losing prompts.

tools.name: refresh_brand
tools.description: Trigger a fresh scan across every engine whose API key is set.
